info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Insurance Claims Claims Estimates-v2-spec
info.description: The Insurance Claims Estimates API provides clients with access to comprehensive estimates related to insurance claims. By utilizing this endpoint, users can retrieve detailed information about claim estimates, enabling them to better understand potential costs and liabilities. This API is particularly useful for insurance adjusters, claims managers, and financial analysts who need precise estimates for decision-making and reporting. Seamlessly integrate this functionality into your applications to enhance your claims management process and improve customer communication.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to obtain an estimate based on the claims submitted. It provides crucial information to help users understand potential outcomes and financial estimates.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving an estimate of claims. This payload should contain the necessary details to process the estimate accurately.

202.description: The request has been accepted for processing and is not yet completed.

ListInsuranceClaimsClaimsEstimatesReques.description: Represents the request body for getting an estimate in the claims operations. This should be a valid string that describes the estimation request.

status.description: Indicates the success status of the request.

referenceNumber.description: A unique identifier for the reference associated with the estimate.

resultId.description: The unique identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: The current state of the estimate request.

processingTimeMs.description: The total time taken to process the request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the result of the operation.

ListInsuranceClaimsClaimsEstimatesRespon.description: Response schema for the GET estimate operation concerning claims, indicating the status and details of the request.

createdBy.description: The username or identifier of the individual or system that created the estimate.

createdAt.description: The timestamp of when the estimate was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the creation of the estimate was automated.

AuditDetails.description: Audit details for tracking the creation and modification of the estimate.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time taken by the server to process the request, measured in milliseconds.
